caption: The request path of a MERN product page: React asks Node.js, the Express route queries MongoDB, and 20 products × 0.6 KB come back as 12 KB. Peak traffic is 8 req/s against a 40 req/s maximum, leaving 32 req/s spare—4 times peak.

spec.aria: A vertical request path from React to Node.js runtime to Express route to MongoDB, with a return edge labelled 12 KB = 20 × 0.6 KB; Express is marked 8/40 req/s with 32 spare equal to 4 times peak.
